summary: Space Quest is a browser-based space exploration game where you pilot a rocket to the Moon, an asteroid, or Mars. Steer by dragging your finger or using arrow keys, dodge asteroids, and collect fuel and stars to keep your mission alive. Earn stars to upgrade your hull, fuel tank, and engine for tougher journeys. Behind the fun are real engineering ideas: balancing mass, fuel, power, and travel time, just like mission teams do. Space missions matter because they improve weather forecasting, communications, and technology on Earth while inspiring students toward science careers. Space Quest makes those lessons hands-on and fun.
details: Space Quest is a browser game where players pilot a rocket to the Moon, an asteroid, or Mars. You steer by dragging or using arrow keys, dodge asteroids, collect fuel and stars, and spend stars on upgrades. Benefits: it is free, needs no installation, and teaches mass, fuel, power, and trajectory trade-offs. The intended impact is to make space science exciting and accessible, inspiring students toward STEM careers.
